polynomial_class.classification: If F is nonconstant, identity J_v=0 for every local solution iff G(conj(w))=lambda*conj(Fprime(w)), lambda real. Constant F permits any G.
polynomial_class.scope: polynomials with constant complex coefficients; not a norm-preserving classification
polynomial_class.conditional_gain: For F(0)=Fprime(0)=0 and a globally smooth compact solution with J=0, d_u log(aout/ain)=2*lambda*integral a*abs(Fprime)**2 dv; sign follows lambda.

scattering: For every globally smooth compactly supported solution, Im(conj(Zout)*Zoutprime)=Im(conj(Zin)*Zinprime)=J pointwise at fixed right characteristic label.
scope: Exact local complex PDE identities and necessary scattering constraints; no unrestricted global existence, complete integrability, source physical parity or quantum scattering conclusion.
